create_gate_linear_layer: create a GateLinear MoE gate layer with specified input and output sizes for fused MoE routing
set_gate_linear_out_dtype: set the output dtype of a GateLinear layer after initialization for expert quantization compatibility
run_gate_linear_forward: run a GateLinear forward pass with three-tier GEMM dispatch across DSV3, cuBLAS, and fallback paths
build_gate_linear_with_fp32_compute: build a GateLinear layer with force_fp32_compute enabled for platforms without specialized kernel support
review_gate_linear_dispatch: review the GateLinear three-tier GEMM dispatch logic selecting DSV3, cuBLAS, or ReplicatedLinear based on platform and dtype
